name: Wind and Waves
description: Wind, gusts, waves, swell and water temperature for any beach, with a 3-day chart that rates each hour for surfing and sailing.
prompt: A wind and waves app for surfers and sailors using the free Open-Meteo forecast and marine APIs with no key. Search a beach or use my location. Show wind speed, gusts and direction with an animated compass arrow, wave height, wave period and swell direction, water temperature, and a 3 day hourly chart. Rate each hour as good, fair or poor for surfing and for sailing with colours.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Viento, rachas, olas, mar de fondo y temperatura del agua en cualquier playa, con un gráfico de 3 días que puntúa cada hora para surf y vela.
